G5000.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «06646»); the gazelle; Tabitha (i.e. Tabjetha), a Christian female:--Tabitha.

G5001.def: from «5021»; something orderly in arrangement (a troop), i.e. (figuratively) a series or succession:--order.

G5002.def: from «5021»; arranged, i.e. appointed or stated:--set.

G5003.def: from «5005»; to be wretched, i.e. realize one's own misery:--be afflicted.

G5005.et: from the base of (5007) and a derivative of the base of (3984)
G5005.def: from the base of «5007» and a derivative of the base of «3984»; enduring trial, i.e. miserable:--wretched.

G5006.def: from «5007»; talent-like in weight:--weight of a talent.

G5007.et: from a presumed derivative of the original form of tlao (to bear, equivalent to (5342))
G5007.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the original form of tlao (to bear; equivalent to «5342»); a balance (as supporting weights), i.e. (by implication) a certain weight (and thence a coin or rather sum of money) or "talent":--talent.

G5008.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «02924»); the fresh, i.e. young girl; talitha (O maiden):--talitha.

G5009.et: contraction of a presumed derivative of tamias (a dispenser or distributor
G5009.def: neuter contraction of a presumed derivative of tamias (a dispenser or distributor; akin to temno, to cut); a dispensary or magazine, i.e. a chamber on the ground-floor or interior of an Oriental house (generally used for storage or privacy, a spot for retirement):--secret chamber, closet, storehouse.

G5010.def: from «5021»; regular arrangement, i.e. (in time) fixed succession (of rank or character), official dignity:--order.

G5011.def: of uncertain derivation; depressed, i.e. (figuratively) humiliated (in circumstances or disposition):--base, cast down, humble, of low degree (estate), lowly.

G5012.et: from a compound of (5011) and the base of (5424)
G5012.def: from a compound of «5011» and the base of «5424»; humiliation of mind, i.e. modesty:--humbleness of mind, humility (of mind, loneliness (of mind).

G5013.def: from «5011»; to depress; figuratively, to humiliate (in condition or heart):--abase, bring low, humble (self).

G5014.def: from «5013»; depression (in rank or feeling):--humiliation, be made low, low estate, vile.

G5015.def: of uncertain affinity; to stir or agitate (roil water):--trouble.

G5016.def: feminine from «5015»; disturbance, i.e. (of water) roiling, or (of a mob) sedition:--trouble(-ing).

G5017.def: masculine from «5015»; a disturbance, i.e. (popular) tumult:--stir.

G5018.def: from «5019»; a Tarsean, i.e. native of Tarsus:--of Tarsus.

G5019.et: perhaps the same as tarsos (a flat basket)
G5019.def: perhaps the same as tarsos (a flat basket); Tarsus, a place in Asia Minor:--Tarsus.

G5020.et: from Tartaros (the deepest abyss of Hell)
G5020.def: from Tartaros (the deepest abyss of Hades); to incarcerate in eternal torment:--cast down to hell.

G5021.et: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which latter appears only in certain tenses)
G5021.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which latter appears only in certain tenses); to arrange in an orderly manner, i.e. assign or dispose (to a certain position or lot):--addict, appoint, determine, ordain, set.

G5022.def: apparently a primary word (compare «08450», "steer"); a bullock:--bull, ox.

G5023.et: nominative or accusative case neuter plural of (3778)
G5023.def: nominative or accusative case neuter plural of «3778»; these things:--+ afterward, follow, + hereafter, × him, the same, so, such, that, then, these, they, this, those, thus.

G5024.pos: 1. even, thus, in the same way
G5024.et: neuter plural of (3588) and (846) as adverb
G5024.def: neuter plural of «3588» and «846» as adverb; in the same way:--even thus, (manner) like, so.

G5025.et: dative case and accusative case feminine plural respectively of (3778)
G5025.def: dative case and accusative case feminine plural respectively of «3778»; (to or with or by, etc.) these:--hence, that, then, these, those.

G5026.et: dative case, accusative case and genitive case respectively of the feminine singular of (3778)
G5026.def: dative case, accusative case and genitive case respectively of the feminine singular of «3778»; (towards or of) this:--her, + hereof, it, that, + thereby, the (same), this (same).

G5028.def: masculine from «2290»; a grave (the place of interment):--sepulchre, tomb.

G5029.def: as if neuter plural of «5036» (adverbially); shortly, i.e. (figuratively) possibly:--peradventure(-haps).

G5030.def: adverb from «5036»; briefly, i.e. (in time) speedily, or (in manner) rapidly:--hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, suddenly.

G5032.et: neuter singular of the comparative of (5036) (as adverb)
G5032.def: neuter singular of the comparative of «5036» (as adverb); more swiftly, i.e. (in manner) more rapidly, or (in time) more speedily:--out (run), quickly, shortly, sooner.

G5033.et: neuter plural of the superlative of (5036) (as adverb)
G5033.def: neuter plural of the superlative of «5036» (as adverb); most quickly, i.e. (with «5613» prefixed) as soon as possible:--+ with all speed.

G5034.def: from the same as «5036»; a brief space (of time), i.e. (with «1722» prefixed) in haste:--+ quickly, + shortly, + speedily.

G5035.def: neuter singular of «5036» (as adverb); shortly, i.e. without delay, soon, or (by surprise) suddenly, or (by implication, of ease) readily:--lightly, quickly.

G5036.def: of uncertain affinity; fleet, i.e. (figuratively) prompt or ready:--swift.

G5037.pos:
1. not only ... but also
  2. both ... and
  3. as ... so
G5037.et: a primary particle (enclitic) of connection or addition
G5037.def: a primary particle (enclitic) of connection or addition; both or also (properly, as correlation of «2532»):--also, and, both, even, then, whether. Often used in composition, usually as the latter participle.

G5038.def: akin to the base of «5088»; a wall (as formative of a house):--wall.

G5039.et: from a presumed derivative of tekmar (a goal or fixed limit)
G5039.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of tekmar (a goal or fixed limit); a token (as defining a fact), i.e. criterion of certainty:--infallible proof.

G5040.def: diminutive of «5043»; an infant, i.e. (plural figuratively) darlings (Christian converts):--little children.

G5041.et: from a compound of (5043) and the base of (1096)
G5041.def: from a compound of «5043» and the base of «1096»; to be a child-bearer, i.e. parent (mother):--bear children.

G5042.def: from the same as «5041»; childbirth (parentage), i.e. (by implication) maternity (the performance of maternal duties):--childbearing.

G5043.def: from the base of «5098»; a child (as produced):--child, daughter, son.

G5044.def: from a compound of «5043» and «5142»; to be a childrearer, i.e. fulfil the duties of a female parent:--bring up children.

G5045.def: from the base of «5098»; an artificer (as producer of fabrics), i.e. (specially), a craftsman in wood:--carpenter.

G5046.def: from «5056»; complete (in various applications of labor, growth, mental and moral character, etc.); neuter (as noun, with «3588») completeness:--of full age, man, perfect.

G5048.def: from «5046»; to complete, i.e. (literally) accomplish, or (figuratively) consummate (in character):--consecrate, finish, fulfil, make) perfect.

G5049.def: adverb from «5046»; completely, i.e. (of hope) without wavering:--to the end.

G5050.def: from «5448»; (the act) completion, i.e. (of prophecy) verification, or (of expiation) absolution:--perfection, performance.

G5052.def: from a compound of «5056» and «5342»; to be a bearer to completion (maturity), i.e. to ripen fruit (figuratively):--bring fruit to perfection.

G5053.def: from a presumed derivative of «5055»; to finish life (by implication, of «979»), i.e. expire (demise):--be dead, decease, die.

G5055.def: from «5056»; to end, i.e. complete, execute, conclude, discharge (a debt):--accomplish, make an end, expire, fill up, finish, go over, pay, perform.

G5056.et: from a primary tello (to set out for a definite point or goal)
G5056.def: from a primary tello (to set out for a definite point or goal); properly, the point aimed at as a limit, i.e. (by implication) the conclusion of an act or state (termination (literally, figuratively or indefinitely), result (immediate, ultimate or prophetic), purpose); specially, an impost or levy (as paid):--+ continual, custom, end(-ing), finally, uttermost. Compare «5411».

G5057.def: from «5056» and «5608»; a tax-farmer, i.e. collector of public revenue:--publican.

G5058.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of «5057»; a tax-gatherer's place of business:--receipt of custom.

G5059.def: of uncertain affinity; a prodigy or omen:--wonder.

G5060.def: of Latin origin; third; Tertius, a Christian:--Tertius.

G5061.def: of uncertain derivation; Tertullus, a Roman:--Tertullus.

G5063.def: from «5062» and «2094»; of forty years of age:--(+ full, of) forty years (old).

G5066.def: from «5064»; pertaining to the fourth day:--four days.

G5069.et: from a presumed derivative of tetras (a tetrad, from (5064))
G5069.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of tetras (a tetrad; from «5064»); a quaternion or squad (picket) of four Roman soldiers:--quaternion.

G5070.et: from the multiplicative adverb of (5064) and (5507)
G5070.def: from the multiplicative adverb of «5064» and «5507»; four times a thousand:--four thousand.

G5071.def: plural from «5064» and «1540»; four hundred:--four hundred.

G5072.et: neuter of a compound of (5064) and (3376)
G5072.def: neuter of a compound of «5064» and «3376»; a four months' space:--four months.

G5073.et: from (5064) and a derivative of the base of (4118)
G5073.def: from «5064» and a derivative of the base of «4118»; quadruple:--fourfold.

G5075.def: from «5076»; to be a tetrarch:--(be) tetrarch.

G5076.def: from «5064» and «757»; the ruler of a fourth part of a country ("tetrarch"):--tetrarch.

G5077.def: from tephra (ashes); to incinerate, i.e. consume:--turn to ashes.

G5078.def: from the base of «5088»; art (as productive), i.e. (specially), a trade, or (generally) skill:--art, craft, occupation.

G5079.def: from «5078»; an artisan; figuratively, a founder (Creator):--builder, craftsman.

G5080.def: apparently a primary verb; to liquefy:--melt.

G5081.et: from a compound of a derivative of (5056) and (827)
G5081.def: adverb from a compound of a derivative of «5056» and «827»; in a far-shining manner, i.e. plainly:--clearly.

G5082.pos:
1. of age
    1. of such an age
    2. of so great an age, so old
    3. so young
  2. of so great a size, in bulk
  3. such and so great
G5082.et: from a compound of (3588) with (2245) and (3778)

G5083.et: from teros (a watch, perhaps akin to (2334))
G5083.def: from teros (a watch; perhaps akin to «2334»); to guard (from loss or injury, properly, by keeping the eye upon; and thus differing from «5442», which is properly to prevent escaping; and from «2892», which implies a fortress or full military lines of apparatus), i.e. to note (a prophecy; figuratively, to fulfil a command); by implication, to detain (in custody; figuratively, to maintain); by extension, to withhold (for personal ends; figuratively, to keep unmarried); by extension, to withhold (for personal ends; figuratively, to keep unmarried):--hold fast, keep(- er), (pre-, re-)serve, watch.

G5084.def: from «5083»; a watching, i.e. (figuratively) observance, or (concretely) a prison:--hold.

G5085.def: from «5086»; Tiberias, the name of a town and a lake in Palestine:--Tiberias.

G5086.def: of Latin origin; probably pertaining to the river Tiberis or Tiber; Tiberius, a Roman emperor:--Tiberius.

G5087.et: a prolonged form of a primary theo {theh'-o} (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses)
G5087.def: to place (in the widest application, literally and figuratively; properly, in a passive or horizontal posture, and thus different from «2476», which properly denotes an upright and active position, while «2749» is properly reflexive and utterly prostrate):--+ advise, appoint, bow, commit, conceive, give, × kneel down, lay (aside, down, up), make, ordain, purpose, put, set (forth), settle, sink down.

G5088.et: a strengthened form of a primary teko {tek'-o} (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses)
G5088.def: a strengthened form of a primary teko tek'-o (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses); to produce (from seed, as a mother, a plant, the earth, etc.), literally or figuratively:--bear, be born, bring forth, be delivered, be in travail.

G5089.et: perhaps akin to the alternate of (138), and thus to (4951)
G5089.def: perhaps akin to the alternate of «138», and thus to «4951»; to pull off:--pluck.

G5090.def: probably of Chaldee origin (compare «02931»); Timoeus (i.e. Timay), an Israelite:--Timaeus.

G5091.def: from «5093»; to prize, i.e. fix a valuation upon; by implication, to revere:--honour, value.

G5092.def: from «5099»; a value, i.e. money paid, or (concretely and collectively) valuables; by analogy, esteem (especially of the highest degree), or the dignity itself:--honour, precious, price, some.

G5093.def: from «5092»; valuable, i.e. (objectively) costly, or (subjectively) honored, esteemed, or (figuratively) beloved:--dear, honourable, (more, most) precious, had in reputation.

G5095.def: from «5092» and «2316»; dear to God; Timotheus, a Christian:--Timotheus, Timothy.

G5097.et: from a comparative of (5092) and ouros (a guard)
G5097.def: from a comparative of «5092» and ouros (a guard); properly, to protect one's honor, i.e. to avenge (inflict a penalty):--punish.

G5098.def: from «5097»; vindication, i.e. (by implication) a penalty:--punishment.

G5099.et: strengthened for a primary tio {tee'-o} (which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses)
G5099.def: to pay a price, i.e. as a penalty:--be punished with.
